input_zh: Reading 权威控制固定于 main 提交 1a29b71f72f9a848d929487cdbc926c1090463a0：Research Runtime Scheduler V3.0、Worker Control v1.3.0、Generated Reading Prompt v1.0.0；声明 SHA-256 为 9ad93d7f4cd7859fc0b32fa9b3b9e2b836a177c889addcc67d0b4fdc3261d7b5，同一提交上的全部 5 个 requiredSources 均完整读取。已对精确 Generated Prompt 字节执行确定性 SHA-256 计算并与声明值一致。唯一已核验的同日 Wake Receipt 为 research/runtime/wakes/2026/09/2026-09-11/reading-110719.json。Ordered Runtime Reconciliation 于 11:12:28+08:00 开启 Reading，原生 Worker Claim 路径于 11:13:39+08:00 在提交 5c27e2a62095e94abab854c3a88c7a949e9fe793 中持久记录 Worker Claimed。Reading 只消费同日已完成的 Queue Plan research/runtime/plans/2026/09/2026-09-11-plan.json，其中 Q-20260911-01 与 Q-20260911-02 为 Selected，Open-source Engineering 明确为 No Selection。
workResult: Completed source-complete Deep Reading for both same-date Selected objects and produced two durable Reading Notes. Q-20260911-01 read the complete ROAM primary study across immutable atomic-memory representation, five-way relation taxonomy, deterministic relation precedence, Primary/Evidence role transitions, fused retrieval views, conflict and temporal updates, LongMemEval/MEME-Post/controlled-confounder evaluation, baseline comparisons, ablations, context-budget behavior and limitations. The bounded finding is that long-term agent memory should preserve source observations more durably than the model's current semantic interpretation: atomic evidence can remain immutable while Primary/Evidence roles and active retrieval views change, so source identity, semantic relation judgment, retrieval authority and recovery history should remain separate state identities. Non-destructive storage does not prove that demoted evidence remains equally visible at answer time, and memory-QA performance does not prove authorization or organizational truth. Q-20260911-02 read the complete UnitBoost primary study across unit abstraction, constrained deterministic selection, order-invariance, provenance, residual construction, later-round targeting, six compound-system configurations, held-out benchmarks, FanOutQA results, explicit negative conditions, coupling/repair-cost analysis and limitations. The bounded finding is that deterministic coordination can replace generative management only where stable work units, admissibility constraints and sufficiently weak coupling are observable; deterministic selection improves reproducibility and provenance but does not by itself prove semantic correctness, authorization or effect safety. The exact two-note head 963a8db696999d8c72fe334c8f5f5150b16b745b passed Validate Research Center 3.0 run 34558173003 with completed/success before terminal finalization. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication.
workResult_zh: 已对两个同日 Selected Object 完成来源完整 Deep Reading，并生成两份持久 Reading Note。Q-20260911-01 完整深读 ROAM 一手研究的 Immutable Atomic Memory Representation、五类 Relation Taxonomy、确定性 Relation Precedence、Primary/Evidence Role Transition、Fused Retrieval View、冲突与时间更新、LongMemEval/MEME-Post/受控干扰项评测、Baseline Comparison、Ablation、Context-budget 行为与限制。边界结论是：长期 Agent Memory 应当让 Source Observation 比模型当前的 Semantic Interpretation 更难被改变；Atomic Evidence 可以保持不可变，而 Primary/Evidence Role 与 Active Retrieval View 可以变化，因此 Source Identity、Semantic Relation Judgment、Retrieval Authority 与 Recovery History 应保持为不同状态身份。Non-destructive Storage 不等于被降级的 Evidence 在 Answer Time 仍具有同等可见性，Memory-QA 成绩也不能被扩大成 Authorization 或 Organizational Truth 的证明。Q-20260911-02 完整深读 UnitBoost 一手研究的 Unit Abstraction、Constrained Deterministic Selection、Order-invariance、Provenance、Residual Construction、后续轮次定向、6 个 Compound-system Configuration、Held-out Benchmark、FanOutQA 结果、显式 Negative Condition、Coupling/Repair-cost 分析与限制。边界结论是：只有在 Stable Work Unit、Admissibility Constraint 与足够弱的 Coupling 可观察时，Deterministic Coordination 才适合替代 Generative Management；确定性选择可以提高可复现性与 Provenance，但本身不能证明 Semantic Correctness、Authorization 或 Effect Safety。精确两份 Note Head 963a8db696999d8c72fe334c8f5f5150b16b745b 已在终态收口前通过 Validate Research Center 3.0 Run 34558173003，状态 completed/success。Reading 未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化、Production 或 Publication。
